info.name: Electronics Store Backend
info.description: CIT4040 course project. Import the environment too, run 01 Auth first, then any folder.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Run this folder first. It logs in the seeded accounts and stores their tokens in the environment.

exec: pm.test("Location header is set", function () { pm.response.to.have.header("Location"); });
pm.test("No password in the response", function () { pm.expect(json).to.not.have.property("password"); });
pm.test("Standard error body", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); ["timestamp","status","error","message","path","details"].forEach(k => pm.expect(j).to.have.property(k)); });
pm.test("details names the email field", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().details).to.have.property("email"); });
pm.test("Standard error body", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); ["timestamp","status","error","message","path","details"].forEach(k => pm.expect(j).to.have.property(k)); });
